acceptanceCriteria: A purely additive pool change (new member; a raised pool size limit where one applies) is handoff-compatible for live attempts whose own member, pool settings and budgets are unchanged; a test replays the #643 sequence and the handoff succeeds.
Any other policy change that affects the attempt still fences it STALE_POLICY (counterexample tests).
policy update reports which live attempts it will fence before it commits (or the spec states why not).
The spec amendment is recorded as proposed until the owner accepts.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#643: an OWNER policy update that only added member lane-3 to pool demo-lanes made four later HANDOFF/REVIEW_RETURNED releases of attempts claimed before it refuse with STALE_POLICY (retryable:false); one stranded a G2 verifier verdict and charged a retry plus quarantine. Related: V1-0882 (TTL-only policy change).

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#648 (rc3 batch 4), merged to main 2026-10-07T12:32:21Z as 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 (head 580fcde4, base 0c27e35f48581601fbfaf9613d0216b5f8ca3a46). Evidence (each digest is that file's sha256 at the merge commit): sealed CEM .corvint/changes/4497acbdc2443a7558337ed650bcea433fc9ae64.cem.json; docs/decisions/0439-rc3-batch-4-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md (owner acceptance of the batch 4 requirements); docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0888-additive-pool-handoff.md; docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0889-live-upgrade.md. Manual route because native completion is refused for a reason unrelated to evidence: on V1-0904, claim, submit (tree 6b9f2b71) and gate run focused-docs in a clean worktree at the merge commit all succeeded, but complete --commit 8c02f255 refused STALE_TREE with warning 'commit 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 is not reachable from main'. Local main in the primary checkout is cd70ba0a and holds 2,651 uncommitted paths that may not be touched, so it cannot be fast-forwarded; that attempt was released with reason STALE_TREE. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, live fleet qualification where the spec says so; macOS CPU ticks not delivered (decision 0439 limits).

title: corvint-tasks: adding a pool member fences every live pooled attempt's hand-off with STALE_POLICY (GitHub #643)
